summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers and the plot function, and refactored the three ignite handlers into thin adapters. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; NIfTI writer default dtype changed to np.float32; SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver (new filename parameter) and TensorBoardImageHandler (new index parameter) delegate to these. output_path renamed to output_dir in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py updated to pass filename. Nothing was run: tests, installs, and repository code were not executed, so behaviour and flake8 are unverified; only static checks on line length, file endings, and leftover names were done. Docs (docs/source/data.rst, visualize.rst) do not list the new modules and were not updated. No commits made.
